description:
Optimize the reference generator- and parity-check materialization for the survey's selected workload dimensions, keeping results bit-identical to the reference implementation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The optimized path produces results equal to the reference materialization on the workload-selection dimensions, packed binary and field-generic.
- [hard] REQ-02: The caller-buffer path avoids intermediate allocation, verified by tests, and throughput on the selected workload improves over the unoptimized reference measurably on the bench harness.
title: Optimize the reference generator-matrix materialization
